title: GitHub Security Lab AI agent helps find OpenLibrary barcode-scanner XSS
ai_system: GitHub Security Lab AI agent and CodeQL
summary: OpenLibrary barcode scanner accepts a returnTo query value and assigns it to location after ISBN scanning; a JavaScript URL can execute in the user’s browser.
ai_role: GHSL credits CodeQL and an AI agent developed by GitHub Security Lab. It reports the issue on 2025-09-08 and says it was fixed and deployed 2025-09-10. The public record does not separate the AI agent’s contribution from CodeQL’s.
classification_note: The advisory documents the finding and its disclosure/remediation state. It does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL says the issue was fixed and deployed on 2025-09-10; the advisory does not name a commit or fixed release. No CVE was established.
